lines.en: I fly in a flurry across the cave roof
My wings beat fast

lines.zh: 我从裂开的岩壁挤出来
lines.en: I squeeze out of the split rock
I cross close along the cave wall
My wings stir up dust
I dip and rise as I fly
I circle a stone pillar
I clip the cave roof
My cry echoes in the cave
I fly low, over your head
I brush along the whole cave roof
I bank sharply on a wingbeat

lines.zh: 我从这根石梁飞到那根
lines.en: I fly from this stone beam to that one
I fly over the pool in the cave

lines.zh: 我上下起伏着穿过洞道
lines.en: I weave up and down through the tunnel
I fly urgently, with no direction
I hang upside down from the roof
My wings wrap my body
I hear every sound in the cave
I listen to the water in the cave
I hang under the crack without moving
My eyes are small in the dark
I wait for something to come in
I turn my head the other way
I give a soft cry
I hang upside down, quite secure
My head goes under my wing

lines.zh: 我挂在最暗的那片洞顶
lines.en: I hang from the darkest part of the roof

lines.zh: 火光来了，我的影子躲起来
lines.en: Torchlight comes; my shadow hides

lines.zh: 我的耳朵能听见你的心跳
lines.en: My ears can hear your heartbeat
I do not like you standing below
Have you come to catch me, then
I am three blocks above your head
You look up slowly
You can't catch me in the air
Move and I change position
There is plenty of room in this cave
Do not come any closer to me
I was struck on the wing
I dropped a few blocks in the air
I cry and fly erratically
Eight health will not last many hits
My ears are flattened
I hit the cave wall
I crawl into a rock crack
My wings will not stop shaking
My cry has gone shrill
My wings can still beat
Is that a bug
What are you waving in your hand
I cannot smell anything
I cannot see clearly up here
Lift it a little higher
This does not look edible
I have eaten my fill on the cave roof
Put it down and I will come look
I tilted a little toward you
In the end I do not move
Your hand struck me
I flipped once in the air

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我掉了几格
lines.en: We collided and I dropped a few blocks
You knocked my wing crooked
I climb a stretch at once
That left me confused for a moment
I bank away and swoop back
Do not sweep my wings with light
Your hand carries warmth
You walk your way, I fly mine
The cave has no need of this
We find each other by calls
My colony is not in this patch
To find a mate, follow the calls
Such things happen on the cave roof
I called twice in the cave
I have not let go with my claws
I give only a shriek
I turn over in the air
I turn and dart into the dark
I dive and snatch it
This is not even one mouthful
One flick of my claw lifts it
I can see things on the ground clearly
I fly back up to the roof
This will not fill a gap in my teeth
I dropped it
I circle once with it in my teeth
I land on a rock to eat
I finished it off
Something has come in
I heard its footsteps first
My ears turn toward it
I follow it along the roof

lines.zh: 这个距离我一次俯冲就到
lines.en: One stoop closes this gap
My wings are already spread

lines.zh: 我先叫一声，再看它怕不怕
lines.en: I call once and see if it is afraid
It is far bigger than a bug
I have fixed on its head
I drop a little from the roof
There is movement by the cave mouth
This is more interesting than a bug
I fly along above its head

lines.zh: 它每走一步我就跟一格
lines.en: I match every step it takes

lines.zh: 洞里没有风，我的声音很清楚
lines.en: There is no wind in here, my voice is clear
It never looks up
My shadow moves at its feet
I wait for it to reach low ground
I fly close to the roof
My cry is getting nearer
A little lower is enough

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的血热起来了
lines.en: The blood in my wings has warmed
I trace circles above it

lines.zh: 它的脚步声在洞里被放大
lines.en: Its footsteps are amplified by the cave
I stoop and ram it
My teeth are small but sharp
My wing bone cracks across its nose
I circle once around its head
This one is only four damage
I fly up right after the hit
I bite its ear

lines.zh: 它的手挥过来时我闪开
lines.en: I dodge its swinging hand
I pass by its neck
I slam into the back of its neck

lines.zh: 我从洞顶的暗处飞出来
lines.en: I fly out of the dark of the roof
The cave has gained a sound of wings
I settle on the stone pillar
There is no daylight here
I brought two in from the cave mouth

lines.zh: 我的叫声先在洞里散开
lines.en: My cry spreads through the cave first
I found a spot on the roof
Warmth in the cave draws me out
I hang from the roof watching the cave mouth

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在暗处不显眼
lines.en: My wings are inconspicuous in the dark
The firelight blinds me
I fell from the roof to the ground
The cave water pressed me down

lines.zh: 爆炸把洞顶的碎石全震下来
lines.en: The blast shook all the gravel off the roof

lines.zh: 一支箭穿破了我的翼膜
lines.en: An arrow tears through my wing

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的耳朵嗡嗡响
lines.en: That magic left my ears ringing
There are no bugs left in this cave
The thunder rolled in through the cave mouth
Below turned into an empty chasm
